segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Dana, thanks for jumping on. I wanted to walk through the revised order for 48 seats and make sure the June 24 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that date is still the target. The only thing is finance asked why the onboarding line is $7,500 when the first quote showed $6,000.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, good catch. The $7,500 includes the data import from your legacy system and two admin training sessions. I was buried in the CRM cleanup and deal desk packet yesterday, so I got the corrected quote over this morning instead of calling you back, sorry about that.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No worries. If that includes the import, I can explain it. We just need the invoice split: software on one PO, services on another.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. Software would be $52,800 for the year, net 30, and services would be the separate $7,500 invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the renewal language, is it still auto-renew unless we give 60 days notice?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is, but we can make that 45 days if legal prefers. The term would run July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Forty-five is better. Also, we may add 12 more seats in Q4. Do those just prorate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, same per-seat rate, prorated through the end of the term. No new services fee unless you want extra training.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send the version with 45 days and the split invoices noted, and I’ll route it today.
